'''Castle Pradeux''' was a [[Castle/Legends|castle]] on [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]] named for [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Pers Pradeux]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. Located near the [[Twelve Mounts]], the building was part of the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Prefsbelt Naval Academy]].

By the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the restructuring of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Academy system]], the ancient stones of the castle were dwarfed by the soaring buildings and towers of the rest of the Naval Academy. A multi-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]-long passage linked Castle Pradeux to the [[Naval Crypt]] in the heart of the Twelve Mounts range, where Pers Pradeux's body was entombed. The night before graduation from the Academy, naval [[Midshipman/Legends|Midshipmen]] would walk the length of this pitch-dark passage in silence to the Crypt, where each would dedicate themselves to the naval service.
